signatures.description: Write a Go program (standard library only: bufio/os/fmt) that reads a directed graph and prints the immediate dominator of every vertex using the Lengauer-Tarjan algorithm (semi-NCA or full LT with link-eval); naive iterative bit-vector dataflow will TLE on the worst-case families. Input: first line N M (1 <= N <= 200000, 0 <= M <= 500000), then M lines u v (0-indexed); vertex 0 is the unique entry and some vertices may be unreachable from it. For each i in 0..N-1 print idom[i] on its own line, where idom[0] = 0, unreachable vertices get -1, and idom[i] is the unique strict dominator of i that is dominated by every other strict dominator of i; verify against an O(N*M) reachability brute force on random small graphs and deep chain graphs.
